relations: Pouring clear liquid onto the upper-right brown patch causes it to spread leftward toward the central hole.
The spreading wet patch enlarges the stained area around the hole, partially obscuring the opening.
Continued moisture absorption makes the pre-existing brown stain on the left side glossier and darker.
The vertical drip on the side remains visible while the plate and roll stay fixed.
caption: The video captures a roll of white paper towels standing upright on a white plate with a black rim, set against a dark blurred background and a wooden surface. A large section on the upper-left of the roll is already soaked with a brown liquid that has run down the side, and a dark circular hole sits at the top center. From the top-right corner, a white spout continuously pours a thin stream of clear liquid onto the upper-right surface of the roll. As this stream keeps falling, it feeds a brown wet patch already present there, which spreads leftward toward the central hole. The stained area around the hole grows larger and more saturated, partly obscuring the opening visible earlier. Meanwhile the pre-existing brown stain on the left side becomes glossier and darker, while the vertical drip running down the side remains visible. The plate, roll, and background appear largely fixed, with no obvious camera movement.
